task: B2 Task 8.9 deployment attestation recovery for api-gateway--0000081
purpose: Task 8.9's preflight refused to proceed because the api-gateway serving identity no longer matched deployment-provenance-20260910.json. This record attests the deployment that actually produced the serving revision, so the proof can be re-attempted against a truthful attestation. It certifies deployment identity only; it is not a Task 8.9 result and does not advance any Wave 10 gate.

productionAuthorizationJob.name: authorize-production
productionAuthorizationJob.note: The production environment gate is real and was exercised, but prevent_self_review is disabled and the dispatching actor and the approver are the same account. Recorded so that 'governed deployment' is not read as multi-party approval.

digestEvidence.artifactsTranscribedVerbatimBecause: GitHub deletes these artifacts on 2026-12-10. Their contents are copied here so this attestation survives retention expiry.
digestEvidence.derivationNote: digest-manifest.json is aggregated from service-digest-api-gateway/digest.txt by the aggregate-digests job; both derive from one buildx --metadata-file. They corroborate each other's transcription, not each other's truth.

armActivityLog.scope: Microsoft.App/containerApps/write on api-gateway, resource group wealth-azure-prod-rg

basis: Exactly one containerApps/write on api-gateway occurred on 2026-09-11, and it falls inside the run's Update Container App step window (10:21:17-10:21:39).
The caller presented appidacr=2 (certificate or federated credential). The app registration holds 0 certificates, leaving GitHub OIDC federation as the only appidacr=2 path.
The run's own log captures the ACA response naming api-gateway--0000081 with the matching digest.
manualUpdateExclusion.caveat: No ARM 'Succeeded' event exists for correlation de41b631-8a26-471a-87dd-bd608d93693e; only Started and Accepted. Provisioning success is evidenced by the revision's Provisioned/Healthy state and the run's own poll, not by an ARM terminal event. The 2026-09-10 write does carry Succeeded, so the absence is specific to this correlation.

acrManifest.pushActorNote: ACR has no diagnostic settings, so no registry-side actor log exists. The push is attributed to the run's build step by the 10:21:12.84Z createdTime falling inside that step (10:19:24-10:21:17), not by a registry record.

supersessionChain.changeKind: configuration only; image digest unchanged from 0079
supersessionChain.onlySurvivingRecord: This deploy run's assert-scoped-non-interference BEFORE snapshot. maxInactiveRevisions=0 purged the revision itself.

supersessionNote: The 2026-09-10 provenance record was already stale on revision name before this deployment ran: 0079 had been superseded by 0080 on 2026-09-10 by a configuration-only Terraform change that left the image unchanged. Task 8.9's preflight compares both image and revision, so a config-only rollout is sufficient to invalidate an attestation.

nonInterference.consequence: portfolio-service's 2026-09-09 attestation remains valid and needs no change.

proven: The deploy job checked out exactly 006aa9e6877290a701fe2a124a056299956e7d0a (logged fetch).
That job built with -f api-gateway/Dockerfile.azure --push --no-cache and recorded the resulting digest in its metadata, artifacts, and the az containerapp update argument.
The ACR manifest for that digest exists and is content-addressed.
The serving revision's template image is digest-qualified to that same digest.
Exactly one authenticated ARM write created the revision, inside the run's update step.
assertedNotProven: That the image BYTES correspond to source 006aa9e6877290a701fe2a124a056299956e7d0a. There is no --provenance or --sbom attestation, no OCI source labels, and the Gradle build is not reproducible (--no-cache).
The ACR tag equals github.sha because the workflow sets it; the tag is a label applied by the run, not a property of the content.
The ACR push actor, which is inferred from timing inside the build step rather than from a registry log.
evidenceLimits.characterization: The binding chain source -> checkout -> build -> digest -> ACR -> ACA template is intact and adequate for this schema. It is not a cryptographic provenance attestation and must not be described as one.

independentReview.role: non-operator; the operator did not review its own work
correctionsAdopted: Recorded the 0080 supersession the operator's first packet omitted.
Withdrew the operator's 'five mutually independent places' claim as double-counting; corroboration is two independent systems plus records derived from them.
Replaced proximity-based causality with the ARM single-write and appidacr=2 evidence.

outOfScopeHygiene: The deploy app registration holds 1 password credential (display name 'rbac', valid to 2027-03-12) while deploy-azure.yml's header states no client secret is stored - true of GitHub secrets, not of the app registration.
Federated subject repo:...:pull_request permits any pull_request-triggered workflow with id-token: write to mint tokens for the production service principal.
ACR has no diagnostic settings, so pushes are not independently logged by Azure.
verifierDefects: verify_demo_reset_azure.py populates evidence['serving'] only after a service fully matches, so a mismatch cannot report the observed identity.
classify_task8_9 maps every pre-login failure to class_2a / retry_fresh_end_to_end; tasks.md assigns a manifest mismatch to Class 2d, and a fresh retry is deterministically futile.
validate_deployment_provenance checks evidencePath shape only and never checks the file exists.
